687

Called Meeting of City Council
Austin, Texas, Sept. 30th 1879.
Mayor De Gress presiding.
Roll Called. Present Aldermen, Crow,
Crocker, Halle, Platt, Parm, Sheehan, Strong, and Vaughan
The following business was transacted,
A resolution appropriating $155.00 to pay for extra work on a bridge over a branch of
Shoal Creek on West Pecan St.
Read first time and on motion the rules
were suspended to place the resolution
on its second reading by the following vote
Yeas Aldermen Crow, Crocker, Halle,
Platt, Parm, Sheehan, Strong & Vaughan.
Resolution read second time & on motion
the rules were further suspended and the
resolution placed on its third reading by the following vote: Yeas Aldermen, Crow,
Crocker, Halle, Platt, Parm, Sheehan,
Strong and Vaughan.
The resolution read third time and on motion passed by the following vote: Yeas Aldermen
Crow, Crocker, Halle, Platt, Parm, Sheehan Strong and Vaughan Art. No 309 of the Revised
City Ordinances was referred to the Ordinance Committee with instructions to report to the
next meeting of the
Council such alterations & amendments
as to them might seem proper.
On motion the City Marshall was instrue-
ted to procure a city pound and report
his action at the next meeting.
On motion the Mayor was authorized to
order an election for city officers to be held on the first Monday in Nov. 1879 and to
establish voting places and appoint
judges &c.
The Ordinance Committee were instructed to examine into the Stock Ordinance and make such
recom-mendations as they deem advisable to the next meeting of the Council.
On motion the Council adjourned.
